verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Vim ships with a-Shell and that users can edit files and run syntax checkers through Vim plugins such as vim-lsp or ALE, which covers both halves of the story inside the app. Separate docs confirm editing programs and running them in-app, but syntax checking rests on a single sentence. Missing for 10: detail on whether vim-lsp/ALE are bundled or user-installed, which linters/language servers actually work, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can edit files with a terminal-based editor and run syntax/lint checkers inside the app

citations.quote: a-Shell comes with Vim included. You can edit your files and even run syntax checkers using e.g. vim-lsp or ALE.
Edit your programs and run them inside the app.
